from django.test import TestCase

from catalog.forms import BookForm
from catalog.models import Author, Book


class BookFormTests(TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.author = Author.objects.create(name="Ursula")

                "author": self.author.pk, "published": True, "year": 1969}
        data.update(over)

    def test_valid_form_saves_a_book(self):

        self.assertEqual(Book.objects.count(), 1)

        self.assertTrue(form.is_valid(), form.errors.as_json())
        self.assertEqual(form.save().title, "Darkness")

    def test_short_title_errors_on_title(self):
        form = BookForm(data=self.payload(title="D", confirm_title="D"))
        self.assertFalse(form.is_valid())
        self.assertIn("title", form.errors)

        del data["confirm_title"]
        form = BookForm(data=data)
        self.assertFalse(form.is_valid())
        self.assertIn("confirm_title", form.errors)

"""Acceptance: the ORM behaviour dj01 asks for, exercised for real."""

from django.test import TestCase

from catalog.models import Author, Book


class BookQuerySetTests(TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.ursula = Author.objects.create(name="Ursula")
        self.borges = Author.objects.create(name="Borges")
        Book.objects.create(title="Darkness", author=self.ursula,
                            published=True, year=1969)
        Book.objects.create(title="Dispossessed", author=self.ursula,
                            published=True, year=2004)
        Book.objects.create(title="Unfinished", author=self.ursula,
                            published=False, year=2010)
        Book.objects.create(title="Ficciones", author=self.borges,
                            published=False, year=1944)

    def test_published_returns_only_published(self):
        titles = set(Book.objects.published().values_list("title", flat=True))
        self.assertEqual(titles, {"Darkness", "Dispossessed"})

    def test_since_filters_on_year(self):
        titles = set(Book.objects.since(2000).values_list("title", flat=True))
        self.assertEqual(titles, {"Dispossessed", "Unfinished"})

    def test_chainable_in_both_orders(self):
        a = set(Book.objects.published().since(2000)
                .values_list("title", flat=True))
        b = set(Book.objects.since(2000).published()
                .values_list("title", flat=True))
        self.assertEqual(a, {"Dispossessed"})
        self.assertEqual(a, b)

    def test_related_name_is_books(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.ursula.books.count(), 3)


class WithPublishedCountsTests(TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.ursula = Author.objects.create(name="Ursula")
        self.silent = Author.objects.create(name="Silent")
        Book.objects.create(title="One", author=self.ursula,
                            published=True, year=1990)
        Book.objects.create(title="Two", author=self.ursula,
                            published=True, year=1991)
        Book.objects.create(title="Three", author=self.ursula,
                            published=False, year=1992)

    def test_counts_only_published(self):
        counts = {a.name: a.published_count
                  for a in Author.objects.with_published_counts()}
        self.assertEqual(counts["Ursula"], 2)

    def test_author_without_published_books_still_appears(self):
        counts = {a.name: a.published_count
                  for a in Author.objects.with_published_counts()}
        self.assertIn("Silent", counts)
        self.assertEqual(counts["Silent"], 0)

from django.test import TestCase

from catalog.forms import BookForm
from catalog.models import Author, Book


class BookFormTests(TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.author = Author.objects.create(name="Ursula")

    def payload(self, **over):
        data = {"title": "Darkness", "confirm_title": "Darkness",
                "author": self.author.pk, "published": True, "year": 1969}
        data.update(over)
        return data

    def test_valid_form_saves_a_book(self):
        form = BookForm(data=self.payload())
        self.assertTrue(form.is_valid(), form.errors.as_json())
        book = form.save()
        self.assertEqual(Book.objects.count(), 1)
        self.assertEqual(book.title, "Darkness")

    def test_title_is_stripped_before_saving(self):
        form = BookForm(data=self.payload(title="  Darkness  "))
        self.assertTrue(form.is_valid(), form.errors.as_json())
        self.assertEqual(form.save().title, "Darkness")

    def test_short_title_errors_on_title(self):
        form = BookForm(data=self.payload(title="D", confirm_title="D"))
        self.assertFalse(form.is_valid())
        self.assertIn("title", form.errors)

    def test_mismatch_errors_on_confirm_title_only(self):
        form = BookForm(data=self.payload(confirm_title="Something Else"))
        self.assertFalse(form.is_valid())
        self.assertIn("confirm_title", form.errors)
        self.assertNotIn("title", form.errors)
        self.assertNotIn("__all__", form.errors)

    def test_published_book_with_impossible_year_errors_on_year(self):
        form = BookForm(data=self.payload(year=1200))
        self.assertFalse(form.is_valid())
        self.assertIn("year", form.errors)

    def test_unpublished_book_may_carry_any_year(self):
        form = BookForm(data=self.payload(year=1200, published=False))
        self.assertTrue(form.is_valid(), form.errors.as_json())

    def test_confirm_title_is_required(self):
        data = self.payload()
        del data["confirm_title"]
        form = BookForm(data=data)
        self.assertFalse(form.is_valid())
        self.assertIn("confirm_title", form.errors)

from django.db import models


class Author(models.Model):
    name = models.CharField(max_length=100)


class Book(models.Model):
    title = models.CharField(max_length=200)
    author = models.ForeignKey(Author, on_delete=models.CASCADE,
                               related_name="books")
    published = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    year = models.IntegerField()

"""Acceptance: validation runs, and each error lands where it was asked to."""

from django.test import TestCase

from catalog.forms import BookForm
from catalog.models import Author, Book


class BookFormTests(TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.author = Author.objects.create(name="Ursula")

    def payload(self, **over):
        data = {"title": "Darkness", "confirm_title": "Darkness",
                "author": self.author.pk, "published": True, "year": 1969}
        data.update(over)
        return data

    def test_valid_form_saves_a_book(self):
        form = BookForm(data=self.payload())
        self.assertTrue(form.is_valid(), form.errors.as_json())
        book = form.save()
        self.assertEqual(Book.objects.count(), 1)
        self.assertEqual(book.title, "Darkness")

    def test_title_is_stripped_before_saving(self):
        form = BookForm(data=self.payload(title="  Darkness  "))
        self.assertTrue(form.is_valid(), form.errors.as_json())
        self.assertEqual(form.save().title, "Darkness")

    def test_short_title_errors_on_title(self):
        form = BookForm(data=self.payload(title="D", confirm_title="D"))
        self.assertFalse(form.is_valid())
        self.assertIn("title", form.errors)

    def test_mismatch_errors_on_confirm_title_only(self):
        form = BookForm(data=self.payload(confirm_title="Something Else"))
        self.assertFalse(form.is_valid())
        self.assertIn("confirm_title", form.errors)
        self.assertNotIn("title", form.errors)
        self.assertNotIn("__all__", form.errors)

    def test_published_book_with_impossible_year_errors_on_year(self):
        form = BookForm(data=self.payload(year=1200))
        self.assertFalse(form.is_valid())
        self.assertIn("year", form.errors)

    def test_unpublished_book_may_carry_any_year(self):
        form = BookForm(data=self.payload(year=1200, published=False))
        self.assertTrue(form.is_valid(), form.errors.as_json())

    def test_confirm_title_is_required(self):
        data = self.payload()
        del data["confirm_title"]
        form = BookForm(data=data)
        self.assertFalse(form.is_valid())
        self.assertIn("confirm_title", form.errors)
